text: I just found this app and so far Im loving it. Its what i was looking for in an app. i didnt give it a 5 stars because I wish it had a widget to put on my homescreen as a reminder, but other than that I love it.
author: Ashleigh Griffiths
developer_reply: Thanks for taking the time to review and leave feedback. Feel free to join the discord via the app settings or email me with recommendations directly at habitforgeio@gmail.com. In terms of homescreen widgets, they are on the roadmap! The app is still fairly young and I'm a solo developer, but the features are slowly getting done :)

text: if you are looking for something free this is not it, most if not all of the features are behind a paywall which is subscription based
author: Peter Mlauzi
developer_reply: Thanks for the feedback. I know subscriptions aren't for everyone. I spent over a year building HabitForge and chose subscriptions over intrusive ads or selling data. The free version is a fully functional habit tracker, while gamification and advanced features are premium. There's also a lifetime option for those who prefer a one-time purchase.

text: Есть русский язык, но шрифт мелкий и нельзя его увеличить. Попытка сменить тему с тëмной на светлую приводит к тому, что приложение совсем не работает до тех пор, пока его не удалишь и не установишь заново. Бесплатно пользоваться нормально нельзя, цена дорогая и у нас заплатить невозможно
author: Al Iv
developer_reply: Thanks for the feedback—I really appreciate it. The app is still young and I’m actively improving it.
